candidate.raw_translation: 每手牌都使用四種花色的J、Q、K、A。 右邊的J是王牌,而左邊的J是相同花色的王牌,也是王牌。 玩家必須按照有效的花色進行遊戲,至少有三個玩家能夠取得王牌。 首先取得王牌的玩家為勝。
candidate.source: Each hand uses 9, 10, Jack, Queen, King and Ace in all four suits. The right bower is the Jack of trump; the left bower is the Jack of the same color and also counts as trump. Players must follow the effective suit led when able. A team that makes trump takes at least three tricks. First to the selected target wins.
